Independent direct vertex enumeration agrees on 12 cases. Infinite result does not follow from empirical extrapolation.

value.rationale: The natural three-prime divisor-lattice family has three interacting valuation directions. The full 25-class shallow-logical invariant, unexpected decrease of a coordinate threshold from 7 to 6, nontrivial equivalences of different exponent patterns, and sharp least representative bound 150 are structurally motivated and not textbook deductions from the one-chain theorem.
